figurative_meaning_en: a few harsh or stern words
similar_in_english: give someone a piece of one's mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ছেলেকে দু-চার কথা শোনাল যাতে সে আর ভুল না করে।
ম্যানেজারটি কর্মচারীকে দু-চার কথা বলে সতর্ক করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave his son a few harsh words to ensure he doesn't make the same mistake again.
The manager gave the employee a few stern words as a warning.
note: This idiom is commonly used in informal Bengali speech to indicate mild scolding without deep cultural or historical backstory.
